# Generate migration-test source data.
storage = "abfss://migrationcontainer@transportationmigration.dfs.core.windows.net"

customers = [
    ("C001", "Asha", "Hyderabad"),
    ("C002", "Ravi", "Vijayawada"),
    ("C003", "Priya", "Bengaluru"),
    ("C004", "Arjun", "Chennai")
]

sales = [
    ("S001", "C001", "Laptop", 65000),
    ("S002", "C002", "Phone", 30000),
    ("S003", "C001", "Monitor", 18000),
    ("S004", "C003", "Keyboard", 2500),
    ("S005", "C004", "Laptop", 72000)
]

customers_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    customers,
    ["CustomerId", "CustomerName", "City"]
)

sales_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    sales,
    ["SaleId", "CustomerId", "Product", "Amount"]
)

customers_df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "true").csv(
    storage + "/migration-test/csv/customers"
)

sales_df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "true").csv(
    storage + "/migration-test/csv/sales"
)

customers_df.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    storage + "/migration-test/parquet/customers"
)

sales_df.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    storage + "/migration-test/parquet/sales"
)

print("Migration test CSV and Parquet data created successfully.")
